notes: Explore idea: dynamic time warping as a research-algorithm tool (ventures/dynamic-time-warping); none of 1,384 venture READMEs mentioned it. Engine from Sakoe & Chiba 1978, Itakura 1975, Giorgino 2009 step/window catalogue, Tormene et al. 2009 open-begin/end, Muller 2007 subsequence DTW. Matches dtw-python 1.9.0 on 120 alignments (3 step patterns x none/band3/band6/itakura x abs/squared x 5 shapes): distances to 1e-9 and identical paths; 6 subsequence searches identical. New part: a lag profile reading each point as timing/level/turn/same. Example: NOAA GHCN-Daily Central Park normal highs by calendar day for 5 periods; 1871-1900 vs 1991-2020 (smooth 15, band 37): April -14.3 days, March -23.5, October +7.5; robust to smoothing 0/7 (April -16.1/-14.2); gap/slope estimate 11.9 (Apr) and 7.2 (Oct). No agent doc in docs/reports: the README and research-tools candidates line carry what the next run needs. Preflight: venture-preflight.mjs failed three times (inherited_keys + csv formula guard; hero lede over 120 words; then clean) before the main merge, rerun after it.
